# Tech Stack — Dhruvil Mistry
> Technologies, frameworks, databases, and tooling leveraged by Dhruvil Mistry.

## AI & ML
- **LLMs:** OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Haiku), Google Gemini 2.0 / 1.5 Pro, DeepSeek, Groq.
- **RAG & Agent Frameworks:** LangChain, LlamaIndex, Smolagents, AutoGen.
- **Embeddings & Vector Databases:** Qdrant, Pinecone, ChromaDB, pgvector.
- **Computer Vision & Audio:** PyTorch, Swin Transformers, OpenAI Whisper, Kokoro TTS, Sarvam AI.

## Backend & Systems
- Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Next.js API Routes, WebSockets, RESTful API Design.

## Frontend
- React 19, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI.

## Databases & Cloud
- PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis (Upstash), MongoDB, Docker, Vercel.
